rules.description: Requested quantity must not exceed available stock
rules.reason_template: Requested quantity ({requested_qty}) exceeds available stock ({available_stock}) for {sku}

rules.description: Item must have nonzero stock to be added to cart
Quote referenced at checkout must exist and not be expired
rules.reason_template: Quote {quote_id} has expired (issued {issued_at}, TTL {ttl_seconds}s). Re-quote required.

rules.description: Quote's cart hash must match current cart contents exactly
rules.reason_template: Cart contents changed since quote {quote_id} was issued. Re-quote required.

rules.description: A quote can only be consumed once — prevents replay of the same quote across two checkout attempts (double-spend)
rules.reason_template: Quote {quote_id} has already been consumed by a prior checkout attempt. Re-quote required.

rules.description: The stock reservation created at quote-issue time must still hold at checkout — protects against overselling when two sessions raced for the same limited stock
rules.reason_template: Reservation for {sku} (qty {requested_qty}) is no longer held — it expired or was released. Re-quote required.

rules.description: Requested quantity must be a positive integer
rules.reason_template: Requested quantity ({requested_qty}) for {sku} is not a valid positive integer

rules.description: The amount sent to the payment provider must exactly equal the quote total — never a value supplied by the agent
rules.reason_template: Payment amount (₹{payment_amount}) does not match quote total (₹{quote_total}) for {quote_id}

rules.description: The approver identity must differ from the requesting agent/session — an agent session cannot approve its own high-risk transaction
rules.reason_template: Approval for {quote_id} was attempted by the same session that requested the transaction

rules.description: An approval is only valid for the exact transaction snapshot (cart hash + total) it was granted against — if anything changed after approval, it's void
rules.reason_template: Transaction changed after approval was granted for {quote_id} — approval is no longer valid, must re-request

rules.description: Single transaction over per-transaction cap requires approval
rules.reason_template: Transaction total ₹{total} exceeds auto-approve limit of ₹{threshold_inr}

rules.description: Cumulative session spend over cap requires approval
SKUs flagged high_value always require approval regardless of price threshold logic
rules.reason_template: {sku} is flagged as always requiring approval

rules.description: SKUs flagged restricted cannot be purchased autonomously by an agent under any circumstances
rules.reason_template: {sku} cannot be purchased by an agent without direct human initiation

rules.description: More than 3 checkout attempts in 10 minutes from one session triggers approval
Unverified/new agent sessions have a lower auto-approve ceiling
rules.reason_template: Unverified session attempting purchase (₹{total}) above unverified limit of ₹{unverified_threshold_inr}

resolution_order_note: Engine evaluates ALL rules. If any rule returns BLOCK, final decision is BLOCK regardless of others. Else if any rule returns REQUIRE_APPROVAL, final decision is REQUIRE_APPROVAL. Else ALLOW. This 'strictest wins' logic must never be short-circuited for audit completeness — always run every rule and log every result, even after a BLOCK is found.
